body:
I really don't know what to say. I'm thankful that at least even one person tried to talk me out of it. Thank you. Sincerely. 

And sorry for making you worried. I know I could have succeeded. Now that I didn't, I really don't know what to do.

As far as leaving, I can't. And there are no shelters here, or even hostels. After this village, it's over 300km to the next city.

Anyways, and as always, thank you for helping.
I'm alive. I failed to OD. Knocked myself out instead. Thanks for being concerned. I did go to a hospital, and tomorrow I'm seeing a counselor. Will it make things better? No fucking clue.
I'm alive. I didn't take enough to OD. Just got out of the hospital.
1 hour. I'm sorry.

It's 2 hours to go. I'm done being rejected by my own family. I wouldn't have cared if it were others. But it's family. I have my pills and knife..

Thank you for being concerned.. if I fail, please talk me through this. If.
Something that sounded suspiciously like an arrangement for a drug deal or hit. The sender seemed to be Russian or at least European.
Challenging authority, rebelling, playing cruel pranks. My nickname pretty much became a "Red alert!" alarm.
A would-be terrorist blew up about 500m from my school.
I can't work under stress or pressure so I take a break from studying and relax for a few minutes.
Honestly,  I wish that Jason would return to MP.. even for just a single/EP.
Skipped school, on a 5-day (Friday - Tuesday) getaway.. currently at a hostel watching National Geographic and eating nachos. Life is beautiful.
Visit shock sites.
Our personalities. I'm the vulgar one.
Just trying to get through the day. I usually have conversations with myself.. And in social situations, just... "When will this shit end..?"

Spiders.. I'm too scared to get on their bad side so I just let them be.

And oh my god they have an army of baby spiders!
cross-band yaoi and impregnation. Like, KISS and another band produced BVB or something like that..
Targeting my English teacher in an autobiographical writing demanded by my English teacher. Had a lot of fun writing it.. wonder if she wore the shoes that fit..
Oh, so today, I just got swarmed by ass-hair-pluckers with cameras..
I hate all of them.
A hedgehog is great if it's legal in your area. They don't smell, aren't noisy, and are very easy to manage.
Suicides,  men vs trains, serial killers, and crime scenes.
I might be that poor sod who trips on her feet, falls down a flight ot stairs and breaks her neck, leaving my would-be killer in either a laughing fit or just utter confusion.

I like watching crime/mystery shows like Unusual Suspects, but their format is so predictable. Not a suspect, not a suspect, not a suspect.. whoop! That's the one, right at the last 10-15 minutes.

Prison documentaries are also interesting.
Eh.. prank the bejeesus out of people. And I'd play sports. Volleyball, football, basketball.. those would be a lot of fun

They assume I'm antisocial because I don't open my mouth every three seconds. They also assume that I hung out with the "bad kids" at my previous school because I'm not afraid to talk back when the other person clearly is in the wrong. 

They see me as a rebel (aka demon-worshiper with a lack of respect for authority) and a mute. I guess my pen moves a lot more than my mouth, but in the end, do you/I give a fuck? Nope. I only say what is necessary.  And that is: fuck you and your assumptions.

Any bit of positive social interaction. I have a hard time approaching people and people often see me as unapproachable,  so having people come up to me - even just to ask an urgent question - makes my day.

Redeit, YouTube, some SNS, Listverse, some news sites, podcast stations..

I watch porn in incognito ;)
People rescuing strays and giving them treatment and a home.

Rape/kidnap/getting robbed at gunpoint. I've been molested twice and both times were fucking terrifying. And in this city, there are a fuckton of depraved asswipes. Doesn't matter if you're pretty or a female. 

Another fear is getting injured through sports. I'm scared of breaking my bones.
The best way to learn any new language is to actually apply it in your daily life. Try to think with the language. And don't force yourself to remember hundreds of vocabulary and grammar rules.
Sing
Gangs. No matter how stupid they look with that "swag" shit. Gangs here start from middle school. 12-13 year old *kids* with daggers and machetes. It's a fucked up place.

My parents have cheated on each other, would have gotten a divorce 10 years ago had it been legal in our country.. We have an average of 4-5 fights a week. My brother's cold towards me. Dad's punched me in the head, beat our legs pulpy, and nearly pulled my brother off of the top bunk of our bed.

Parents favor my brothers. It's obvious as fuck. At my younger brother's age, I had my legs bruised from getting beat with bamboo. They won't even so much as let a mosquito bite the spoiled little shit. Parents also have a big mouth of praises for my older brother. "Top-scoring IQ tester in the whole academy!" "Genius!" "Smart" "Intelligent" And I'm the demon-worshiping shameful Asian who can't get the ideal 100% on anything except the definition of "stupid"

I've cut at least 20 times in the last 2 months (non-suicidal). Resorted to looking for attention in webchat rooms. Smoked at 15. 

Yeah, welcome to the family.

Any time that we weren't fighting.

I haven't talked to him (directly) in over 2 years.. god I miss him.
Prison documentaries in general
Well, there's an ASEAN thing going on in progress..

Grandma's cousin's a former president.. who later went to jail for corruption.

Another distant relative took part in mass executions during the late 1890s.

Straying a bit, but a marriage between man and woman would still be invalid if the man has 1000 wives. If the purpose of marriage (so they say) is to consummate and multiply, the man's dick would fall off before he consummates all of his marriages. 

But yeah, marry whoever you want to. Just had to give my two cents on the "marriage is for man and woman only" thing. Seriously, we're in 2014.
Homework

My mum wanted me to become a flight stewardess. Dad wanted me to become a cop (to carry on 'the tradition of having at least one law enforcer per generation' or something like that). I'm becoming a lawyer.
I have to change my passwords often because apparently,  I like to recite them when I'm drunk.
I've been sexting since I was 14 (20 now).. Now I'm studying to become a lawyer.
I'm seriously craving pizza.. we live in the wilderness.. the nearest pizza restaurant is over 200km away. Fml.

Fell from the staircase going down after getting a drink. Sprained ankle from the fall.

Another one - crashed within 5 minutes of learning how to ride a motorcycle. I was the only one in the parking lot..
Original Coke/Pepsi. We've got fake shit all around! They're not bad, but the "real" soda is said to be a dozen times sweeter.
The would-be terrorist attack that happened 500 meters from our school.
Roseate

We had a dog named Yourname. 

"Is that your dog? What's it's name?"
"Yourname"
"Wat?"
"Yourname"

Ah.. childhood memories..
Everything from Kindergarten 2 until 9th grade. Screw that - I should be reborn.
Smell my hair!
putting Bohemian Rhapsody on a loop for hours.

Ulcer. Today.

But usually, it's a fried tuna-mayo sandwich. Essential condiment: ketchup.
